purpose: Define immutable, source-bound observations for project status, readiness, decisions, dependencies, metrics, adoption, and value without turning a dated observation into a timeless fact.
temporal_rules: observed_at, recorded_at, source_as_of, stale_after, valid_from, valid_to, and superseded_at use ISO-8601 dates or timestamps.
valid_to is null for an open interval or is >= valid_from.
superseded_by requires superseded_at; superseded observations are never selected as current.
A missing observation is STALE_OR_UNKNOWN, not green.
An expired observation is STALE_OR_UNKNOWN, not current.
A projection requires an authenticated principal, a closed-world audience, an immutable source-assertion registry, and a known_at cutoff.
An observation is unavailable when recorded_at, source availability, or source_as_of is after known_at, or when a source has been revoked at known_at.
Any current observations with different values are CONFLICT until explicit supersession; a later timestamp alone is not resolution.

projection_rules.current: After W5 source, access, and known_at filtering, select the latest non-superseded observation whose valid interval contains the query time and whose stale_after is not before the query time.
projection_rules.history: Return all source-bound observations for the scope and dimension ordered by observed_at, recorded_at, and observation_id.
projection_rules.missing: Return STALE_OR_UNKNOWN with no fabricated value.
projection_rules.expired: Return STALE_OR_UNKNOWN and expose the stale_after timestamp.
projection_rules.conflict: Return CONFLICT, expose all conflicting observation IDs and values, and require review before a recommendation treats one as authoritative.

graph_migration_posture.target_storage: typed status_observation and metric_observation records linked to canonical source evidence
graph_migration_posture.derived_status_policy: Current status projections remain derived views over observations; they are not mutable properties on project nodes.
